verdict.rationale: Weave's SDK centers evaluations on an `Evaluation` object built from a `Dataset` plus scorers, with an imperative evaluation API and EvaluationLogger. W&B Skills and the official MCP server explicitly let coding agents like Claude Code run evaluations and answer questions about evaluation results. A REST Service API with an OpenAPI spec adds programmatic access. Missing for 10: explicit docs on an agent creating and publishing a dataset (only implied by the Dataset type), detail on reading eval results back via API or MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent-driven loop.
